Figure_Routing_DeliveredPairs_diamond_he.description: delivered_pairs distribution by routing strategy, diamond_heterogeneous, n=20 seeds/strategy (log y-axis: least_loss operates ~50x higher than the other two strategies here)

Figure_Routing_DeliveredPairs_small_mesh.description: delivered_pairs distribution by routing strategy, small_mesh, n=20 seeds/strategy

Figure_Routing_Satisfaction.description: satisfaction rate (SATISFIED / n) with Wilson 95% CI, by routing strategy, both F02 topologies

Figure_Routing_Fidelity_diamond_heteroge.description: average_fidelity distribution by routing strategy, diamond_heterogeneous, n=20 seeds/strategy

Figure_Routing_Fidelity_small_mesh.description: average_fidelity distribution by routing strategy, small_mesh, n=20 seeds/strategy

Figure_Overhead_StageBreakdown.description: (A) total wall time distribution per condition; (B) IBQN's own orchestration sub-stages (planning/deployment/assurance/reconciliation_decision), n annotated per stage since reconciliation_decision is only recorded when a violation triggers it

Figure_Overhead_Ratio.description: orchestration_overhead_ratio distribution (not just mean) per condition, n=20 seeds/condition; below 0.31% of trial wall time in every condition observed here (see docs/overhead_methodology.md for the exact wording - never stated as an absolute/universal 'negligible')

Figure_ResourceSemantics.description: delivered_pairs/delivery_ratio/deliveries_per_reserved_slot vs. reserved_memory_slots, faceted by duration_s, mean +/- 95% CI, n=20 seeds/cell

Figure_FidelityEstimationError.description: absolute_fidelity_error distribution, n=320 trials with a defined estimate (only trials where the plan was feasible/accepted have both an estimated and observed fidelity), grouped by (A) fidelity_estimator and (B) campaign/topology

Figure_Reconciliation_BeforeAfter.description: delivered_pairs per seed, episode 1 -> episode 2, for the 3 recoverable cases plus the severe_loss_attempt case (attempted, never recovers) - fidelity_ceiling_unrecoverable is excluded here since it never reaches a second episode (no_action, see recovery-rate figure)

Figure_Reconciliation_RecoveryRate.description: recovered / reconciliation_attempted with Wilson 95% CI, per scenario class; fidelity_ceiling_unrecoverable shown as an x (0 attempts - no_action is the correct decision, not a missing data point)

Figure_Reconciliation_AdditionalCost.description: (A) additional_wall_time_s distribution for episode 2, by scenario class; (B) how many seeds needed 1 vs. 2 episodes, by scenario class - route/duration/slot adjustments themselves are a fixed 2x multiplier (apply_reconciliation_decision), not a distribution, so their 'magnitude' is not separately plotted

Figure_AssuranceOutcomes.description: counts of SATISFIED/VIOLATED/REJECTED per cell, (A) F02 by scenario x routing_strategy, (B) F03 by scenario x requested_fidelity - all three states occur across both campaigns without being separately forced (n=600 total trials, real final campaigns, not the 2-seed pilot C03_assurance_outcomes)

Figure_Purification_three_node_1_repeate.description: (A) observed fidelity, (B) delivered pairs, vs. requested min_fidelity, three_node_1_repeater; shaded bands distinguish 'rejected but oracle-confirmed satisfiable' from 'rejected, never oracle-tested' - never labeled simply 'infeasible region'

Figure_Purification_linear_chain_2_repea.description: (A) observed fidelity, (B) delivered pairs, vs. requested min_fidelity, linear_chain_2_repeaters (100% REJECTED, never simulated - see panel A); shaded bands distinguish 'rejected but oracle-confirmed satisfiable' from 'rejected, never oracle-tested' - never labeled simply 'infeasible region'

Figure_PlannerOperation_FidelityScatter.description: estimated vs. observed fidelity, n=320 trials with both defined (feasible/accepted trials only), color=estimator, marker=topology, y=x reference line

Figure_PlannerOperation_Matrix.description: 6 planner-decision x operational-outcome categories, explicitly separating 'rejected, never oracle-tested' from 'rejected, oracle confirms satisfiable' from 'rejected, oracle confirms genuinely infeasible' (0 occurrences in this data - shown, not hidden)
